activity.notes: Cheddi Jagan headed the short-lived elected government created by British Guiana's 1953 constitution. The constitutional government was suspended in October 1953. ATLAS separates this first chief-ministerial period from his later return to office.

sources.title: Parliament of Guyana — Guyana Parliament History
sources.citation_text: The parliamentary history documents Jagan as Leader of the House in the first elected ministerial government of 1953.

sources.title: Prime Minister of Guyana — historical office chronology
sources.citation_text: The office chronology gives Jagan's first chief-ministerial term as 30 May to 9 October 1953.
